headline: BAD: Sidi Ould Tah installs a crack team
summary: Sidi Ould Tah has recruited executives from Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Google, the World Bank and the IMF to restructure the African Development Bank's leadership.
why: The African Development Bank is a multilateral lender funding infrastructure and development projects across Africa.
original_headline: BAD : Sidi Ould Tah installe une équipe de choc
